Subject: Request: add GPU capacity + professional services scope change (BrightPath / Redwood)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for last week's demo. We want to move forward but need to capture two changes before we sign:

1) Capacity: bump reserved capacity from 16 GPUs to 24 GPUs for the next 12 months.
2) Services: add an implementation block for integration with our feature-store — estimating ~40 hours of professional services (on-site + remote).

These will change price and billing. Procurement asked me to get an updated order form and any contract amendments (MSA/order form redlines) so they can approve the PO. I attached a short change request doc with the rough numbers.

Questions for you: do we need a change order or an SOW amendment? Any expected lead time for provisioning the additional GPUs?

Thanks —
Talia Brooks
Director of ML Platform
BrightPath.ai
Attachment: BrightPath_Change_Request_July28.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-07-28T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add GPU capacity + professional services scope change (BrightPath / Redwood)

Hi Talia —

Appreciate the clear ask and the doc. Short answer: we can handle this with a change order (order form amendment) plus a short SOW addendum for the professional services.

Suggested next steps:
- I’ll generate a draft change order that adjusts reserved capacity and the recurring rate.
- Legal will add a short SOW for the 40 PS hours with acceptance criteria.
- If procurement needs a PO number or invoice in advance, we can generate a pro forma invoice for the new monthly commitment.

Two quick clarifying items before I draft:
- Is the 24-GPU figure permanent for 12 months or an initial burst for 90 days?
- For PS, do you want Redwood to provide a named resource or an unassigned block?

I’ve looped in Priyom (legal) and Markus (revenue ops) to help with redlines and billing. I’ll send a draft change order by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-29T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add GPU capacity + professional services scope change (BrightPath / Redwood)

Soojin / Markus —

I reviewed the draft change order. High-level legal notes and proposed edits (see attached redline):

1) Price protection: add a clause limiting any price changes for the amended items to the next renewal only. Suggested language: "Pricing for Capacity and Services added by this change order will remain fixed for the then-current term and any adjustments will only apply at the next renewal period."
2) Liability cap alignment: ensure the added PS work is covered by the same liability cap as the MSA; object to uncapped acceptance penalties.
3) Acceptance criteria: SOW must include objective acceptance tests for the integration work (example: successful end-to-end inference job with documented latency under X ms).
4) Term & Billing: clarify whether the extra GPUs start immediately or after signature; if immediate provisioning is requested, include a one-time pro rata charge.

Also flagged for sales: procurement may request a one-time setup fee waiver — recommend we keep a small one-time provisioning fee to cover advance capacity scheduling.

I attached my redline and a short suggested paragraph for the SOW. If we’re comfortable with the pricing, we can package the change order + SOW and send to BrightPath for countersignature and PO.

Attachment: MSA_redlines_Priyom_2026-07-29.docx

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Talia Brooks <talia@brightpath.ai>

Cc: procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: 2026-07-30T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add GPU capacity + professional services scope change (BrightPath / Redwood)

Thanks Priyom and Soojin —

Couple of counterpoints from procurement/ops:
- They want the 24 GPUs to be effective immediately (we have a pilot starting next week). If there’s a pro rata, we can accept it but would prefer it amortized over the first 3 months rather than as a lump.
- For PS, our engineering lead asked if we can reduce the block to 30 hours (we overestimated).
- Procurement will only sign with a standard 30-day invoice term and requires an updated invoice and PO number (I attached the PO).

If Redwood is willing to amortize the setup cost and accept 30 PS hours (instead of 40), we can move quickly. Please provide the redlined change order and an updated invoice/quote so procurement can approve the PO today.

Talia
Attachment: BP_PO_98765.pdf

Talia —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Summary of what I’ll send to BrightPath (and to procurement) in the next email:

- Change order (order form amendment): +8 reserved GPUs (24 total), 12-month term, monthly billing. If you want immediate provisioning, we’ll include a pro rata for the remainder of August amortized over first 3 months per your request.
- SOW addendum: 30 hours of PS (named lead optional), acceptance criteria added per Priyom’s suggested language.
- Pricing: I’ll preserve the current per-GPU rate for the remainder of the term and flag pricing adjustments for renewal only (matches Priyom’s note).
- Invoice: updated quote and pro forma invoice including amortized set-up fee and PO number BP_PO_98765. Net 30 terms included.

Action items:
- Priyom: if you can confirm the redline language for the price protection and acceptance clause by EOD, I’ll finalize and send to Talia and procurement along with the invoice.
- Markus: please confirm billing contact and the exact SKU/pricing we should use for the invoice.

If everyone signs off, I’ll prepare a DocuSign packet (change order + SOW) and the invoice so procurement can approve the PO today.

Thanks —
